features.behavior: Basic 3D world + player movement: Vite + TypeScript + Three.js setup, procedural city ground, third-person player controller with WASD, mouse camera, sprint, jump, health/stamina, smooth follow camera, collision with buildings

Roads/buildings + minimap: Procedural city with roads, buildings, alleys, parks, 3 zones (Downtown, Industrial, Beach), landmarks, fog, skybox, day/night cycle, weather toggle, minimap with roads/player

Vehicles enter/exit/driving: 3 drivable vehicles (car, bike, van/truck), enter/exit, vehicle physics (acceleration, braking, steering, reverse, drift), driving camera, vehicle damage, traffic AI with road-following
NPCs + traffic: Pedestrian NPCs on paths, avoidance behavior, traffic cars on road nodes, crowd flee behavior, daily life animations
Wanted/police system: Wanted level 0-5, increases on crashes/attacks, police spawn/chase at level 2+, more police at high levels, cooldown when escaping LOS, minimap markers for police/player
Missions: 5 missions (Delivery, Taxi, Chase, Escape, Exploration), mission UI with objective/timer/progress, mission markers in world/minimap, data-driven from JSON/TS config
Phone UI + save/load: Phone menu (P key) with Map, Missions, Stats, Vehicles, Settings, social feed, save/load to localStorage (position, money, missions, vehicle, time), reset save

Optimization + README: Instanced meshes, LOD/distance culling, FPS counter, debug panel (teleport, spawn vehicle, set wanted, start mission, toggle day/night/rain/fog), complete README with controls, features, folder structure, limitations, dev log
